nights.title: Gabriella Cilmi
nights.name: Gabriella Cilmi
nights.extract: Gabriella Lucia Cilmi is an Australian and Italian pop singer and songwriter. A contralto, Cilmi is known for her distinctive raspy singing voice.

nights.title: Fat Dog
nights.name: Fat Dog
nights.extract: Fat Dog are an English band, currently consisting of Joe Love, Chris Hughes, Morgan Wallace, and Ellis D. The band formed in 2020 in South East London.
